         1                  THE SECRETARY:    Legislative

         2       Resolution Number 767, by Senators Griffo,

         3       Hannon and Little, memorializing Governor

         4       Andrew M. Cuomo to proclaim May 2011 as Lupus

         5       Awareness Month in the State of New York.

         6                  "WHEREAS, Each year the Lupus

         7       Agencies of New York State designate May as

         8       Lupus Awareness Month to show support for the

         9       105,400 New Yorkers, 1.5 million Americans and

        10       5 million people worldwide who suffer from the

        11       often debilitating effects of lupus, a chronic

        12       autoimmune disease that can cause severe

        13       damage to the tissues and organs in the body,

        14       and in some cases death; and

        15                  "WHEREAS, Each year thousands of

        16       people are newly diagnosed with lupus, a great

        17       majority of whom are young people in the prime

        18       of their lives, and 90 percent of whom are

        19       women; and

        20                  "WHEREAS, Lupus is the most

        21       prevalent among African-Americans, Hispanics,

        22       Native Americans, Asians.  And tragically,

        23       thousands of people die from lupus each year

        24       because a cure remains elusive; and

        25                  "WHEREAS, Many healthcare



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                                         2841



         1       professionals are unaware of symptoms and

         2       health effects of lupus, causing people with

         3       lupus to suffer for many years before they

         4       obtain a correct diagnosis and medical

         5       treatment, demonstrating the need for

         6       increased public and professional awareness of

         7       lupus; and

         8                  "WHEREAS, Medical research efforts

         9       into lupus and the discovery of safer, more

        10       effective treatment for lupus patients are

        11       underfunded in comparison with diseases of

        12       comparable magnitude and severity; and

        13                  "WHEREAS, Increasing community

        14       awareness and focusing public attention on

        15       lupus and its devastating impact on patients'

        16       lives will provide hope for a better future

        17       for those affected; and

        18                  "WHEREAS, The Lupus Agencies of

        19       New York State are dedicated to 'improving the

        20       quality of life for individuals with lupus and

        21       their loved ones by providing education,

        22       support and outreach services and promoting

        23       programs of awareness, advocacy and research';

        24       and

        25                  "WHEREAS, This Legislative Body



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                                         2842



         1       recognizes the needs of those chronically ill

         2       people who are living with lupus and urges all

         3       citizens to support the search for a cure and

         4       assist those individuals and families who deal

         5       with this devastating disease on a daily

         6       basis; now, therefore, be it

         7                  "RESOLVED, That this Legislative

         8       Body pause in its deliberations to memorialize

         9       Governor Andrew M. Cuomo to proclaim May 2011

        10       as Lupus Awareness Month in the State of

        11       New York; and be it further

        12                  "RESOLVED, That copies of this

        13       resolution, suitably engrossed, be transmitted

        14       to the Honorable Andrew M. Cuomo, Governor of

        15       the State of New York, and the Lupus Agencies

        16       of New York State."

         6       affected by this disease.  And we heard how

         9       between the ages of 15 and 44.  So it is so

        10       important, as we try to deal with chronic

        11       illness and diseases such as the lupus issue,

        12       that we continue to make people aware of the

        13       need and the importance of research and

        14       putting together the resources financially

        15       that are necessary to try to help find a cure.

        16                  One example of that is the FDA has

        17       just recently approved a drug called Benlysta.

        18       It's a new form of therapy which is now being

        19       used as a result of clinical trials that they

        20       have now authorized.  And I think this is why

        21       we want to make sure that when we look at

         1       of New York who doctors have been able to

         2       determine that the debilitating disease that

         3       they have been suffering from is lupus.

         4                  How many more women are walking

         5       around and don't know it?  How many more women

         7       symptoms, as Senator Hannon talked about, and

        11       there's about a million who are suffering and

        13       can do something about that by raising

        24       women, it is providing a significant amount of

        25       relief for some.

        14                  SENATOR SQUADRON:    Thank you,

        15       Mr. President, on the resolution honoring

        16       Brook Peters.

        17                  On this week in which the whole

        18       world has turned its attention again to the

        19       attacks of September 11, 2001, in which one

        20       chapter that came out of that day and a result

        21       of that day has been closed, with Osama bin

        22       Laden being brought to justice, I thought it

        23       was appropriate to also highlight what's

        24       happening locally and what's happening on the

        25       personal level in the wake of September 11th.



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                                         2852



         1                  Brook Peters was 4 years old on

         2       September 11, 2001.  He lived in the Lower

         3       Manhattan neighborhood.  Just a few years

         4       later, when he was 11 years old, he started

         5       making a film in which he talked to hundreds

         6       of classmates who had lived in the community,

         7       who were right there, who were directly

         8       affected by the attacks of September 11, 2001.

         9                  And what he found was that for many

        10       of them, they hadn't talked about it with

        11       their parents, their feelings on it were

        12       conflicted, they were still dealing with it.

        13       Much as all of us are, much as the entire

        14       nation and the entire world are still dealing

        15       with it.

        16                  And Brook Peters, who's now in

        17       eighth grade, then submitted his film to the

        18       Tribeca Film Festival, one of the great film

        19       festivals of the world and also an event that

        20       exists in part to help Lower Manhattan,

        21       New York City and New York State to rebuild

        22       from the attacks.  And they accepted the film,

        23       and it was well received at the Tribeca Film

        24       Festival Family Day on Saturday.

        25                  So as all of us approach the tenth



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                                         2853



         1       anniversary of those attacks, as we think this

         2       week both about the fact that we have brought

         3       bin Laden to justice and the fact that

         4       together -- as a city, as a state, as a

         5       nation -- we are continuing to learn from and

         6       rise above those attacks, I think that Brook

         7       Peters' success, his sensitivity, the way that

         8       he has addressed and approached this issue

         9       really should be commended and highlighted.

        10                  And I wanted to take a moment on

        11       the floor of the State Senate to commend and
